component.name: LogRead
component.summary: Read the logs on this computer

description.p: LogRead finds the logs on your computer and shows them by the application or service they belong to, so you do not have to know that the printer writes to /var/log/cups or that your Flatpak app keeps its own log under your home folder.

ul.li: Overview counts the errors and warnings, charts when they happened, and lists the problems that repeat most.
Highlights shows every error and warning as its own card, with a copy button and a count of how often it recurred.
Full log shows the file exactly as written, coloured by severity and searchable.

description.p: It reads plain files, rotated archives, compressed archives and the systemd journal, and works out the format itself — syslog, JSON lines, logfmt, nginx, Apache, Xorg, kernel, dpkg, DNF and pacman among others. Logs that need administrator access are marked, and can be unlocked from the window when you choose to.
